name: Champignon Farmer Quality
description:
A 3x3 woodchip patch for breeding high-quality champignons: each run harvests it, keeps the best mushrooms in the quality container and replants the best of any kind from it.

Bots:
• Champignon Farmer Quality

In each area:
• Crop Quality(Champignon): lay woodchips (nothing to build). Set a harvest stage on it to pick only Cremini or Portobello
• Seeds of crop quality(Champignon): exactly one chest or crate; the best mushrooms are kept in it (the bot stops without one)

Also needed:
• The Quality grid size option set to "3x3" (Options > Farming).
• Optional: the Champignon Farmer preset's container area (seed(Champignon)), used when "Keep quality grind containers at most half full" is on: champignons can't go to a trough, so the low-quality overflow goes to those containers.
